repos.name: alibaba/open-code-review
repos.descriptionZhtw: 開源且免費，經過阿里巴巴大規模實戰檢驗的程式碼審查工具：結合確定性管道與 LLM 代理，提供精確的行級評論，內建經過微調的規則集（包含 NPE、執行緒安全、XSS、SQL 注入檢測），且相容於 OpenAI 與 Anthropic API。
repos.descriptionEn: Open-source & free — Battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in fine-tuned ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
